2026 Scripture Access Statistics

As of 1 August 2026, translation statistics show remarkable progress — work that has accelerated greatly since 2000.

Of the world's 7,393 living languages, most now have some Scripture.

The full Bible is now available in 776 languages, spoken by billions of people worldwide.

The New Testament is available in another 1,798 languages.

Portions of Scripture are available in 1,433 more languages.

Just 544 of the world's living languages remain on the waiting list for Bible translation to begin.
